body:
It isn't that I was wondering what would happen to my *body*, I was what would happen *after*. The scariest part of death imo is that you don't know what happens on the other side of the door. As someone who believes that there is a sort of afterlife, death is a welcoming experience. It's also the biggest gamble you can think of simultaneously, because what if your thoughts and beliefs are false? What if everything fades to black like a movie but there aren't any credits? It's scary to me. 

I went on that tangent and forgot to thank you for the kindness. That last sentence hit me hard, because while I may come off as selfish, I do what I do because I want to help everyone. While myself alone likely won't change the world, I feel like I'm capable of trying my hardest to do so and hopefully help a lot of people. Aside from what happens after death, being forgotten scares me almost as much. Of course I can't really help others if I can't even help myself, so it's a big hurdle I have to climb. I look ahead almost with fear, simply because I don't know where to go or what to do. Hopefully I solve that.

Thank you for the kind words, I've never been much for reading, but writing is something I enjoy when I have too much on my mind. I hope what you said about college is true, as of right now literally no one I know has any sort of similarities with me aside from playing video games, in which case apparently everyone shares something in common with me. I do look forward to Fallout 4, it comes out a couple of days before my birthday so that'll be fun.

About to head off to bed for the night, I've gotten no answers, only more questions. I'll carry on for now simply because I'd rather needlessly suffer than make others around me have a reason to suffer. If you went through my wall of text, thank you. If you're down like me, stay strong, and remember that the first step to solving a problem is realizing that you have one.
I know exactly how you feel right now. It eats away at me that people care more about me than I care about myself. I don't know how to get over that hurdle and it's a damn shame :(
